name: slugify

source.name: Original
source.modifications: Authored for this experiment as a multi-module slug package with shared whitespace helpers, accent folding, title normalisation, segment helpers and reports.

issue: 生成链接标识时，连续出现的标点或分隔符被逐个替换，结果中出现连续连字符。例如 Hello, World 期望得到 hello-world，实际得到 hello--world。请修复该问题，并保持空白归一化、标题大小写、重音折叠、唯一标识、路径渲染与标题渲染的行为不变。
notes: The slug pattern replaces each non-alphanumeric character separately. Two callers share slugify, the direct call and the index report. Whitespace and title helpers are separate modules and are covered by regression tests.
